title: a_short_market_regime_daily
description: Per-trade-day A-share market-regime feature row for the V14.3 comparison-only regime classifier (design slice 1; producer = slice 2, computed inside the EGS run from in-memory all_daily + stk_limit, PIT). NON-production / comparison-only — does NOT drive Phase 5 risk posture. All percentiles use <= as_of windows only; limit detection uses unadjusted daily + stk_limit same-caliber prices.

promotion_rate.description: yesterday-limit-up names that limit up again today / denom; null when denom too small (also flagged insufficient_sample)

csi1000_below_ma20.description: CSI1000 close < its 20d MA (the slow-bleed contraction operand); null when index data unavailable (also flag csi1000_unavailable)

data_quality_flags.description: e.g. insufficient_sample, stk_limit_missing, csi1000_unavailable — never silently coerce

then.description: missing CSI1000 index data (csi1000_below_ma20=null) must be made explicit, never silently coerced: data_quality_flags MUST contain csi1000_unavailable so the slow-bleed operand absence is auditable.
